android.desc:
Learn vocabulary by exploring rich illustrated scenes you can tap at your own pace. VocArt turns everyday language learning into a visual discovery experience, more like an interactive picture dictionary than a traditional study routine.

Open a scene, tap any marked object, and instantly see the word in your target language with translation, romanization where needed, and article or gender when relevant. Each chapter includes ambient sound that matches the setting, and pronunciation audio is available with Premium.

What you can do in VocArt:
- Explore large illustrated chapters filled with everyday words and useful vocabulary
- Tap objects to reveal translations, articles, genders, and romanization
- Practice with 4 exercise types: choose the right image, name what you see, identify the gender, and identify the article
- Study one artwork, one chapter, or your whole collection based on words marked learned, new, or difficult
- Review round summaries and quickly update word status to keep progress moving
- Build a steady habit with streak rewards that unlock 7 days of unlimited exercises after 7 consecutive exercise days

Supported languages:
- Arabic
- Chinese
- German
- English
- Spanish
- French
- Hindi
- Italian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Polish
- Portuguese
- Russian
- Thai
- Turkish
- Ukrainian
- Vietnamese

VocArt is designed for people who remember better through context and images. Seeing vocabulary inside a detailed scene helps connect words to places, objects, and situations you might actually encounter. Instead of jumping through disconnected lists, you learn by noticing, tapping, and revisiting what matters to you.

Progress stays simple and clear. Mark each word as learned, new, or difficult, then focus your practice on exactly that group. Every exercise session ends with a summary of your results, so it is easy to reinforce weak spots and keep building confidence.

If you want a calmer, more visual way to grow your vocabulary and practice everyday words, VocArt offers a fresh approach to language learning through discovery, repetition, and interaction.
